integrity: The exact facet set is independently reconstructed; integral H1=Z^2 is certified by two explicit cocycles and a determinant-one rank-53 boundary minor. The full simplicial automorphism group is exhaustively enumerated and every induced integral and mod-two homology action is replayed.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled twelve-vertex triangulation manifold_3_12_13_4. The result does not classify homology actions for other triangulations of the same manifold or the full topological mapping-class group.
title: Full hexagonal homology action in a twelve-vertex connected-sum triangulation
